title: Outlook Mail Automation
subtitle: A PowerShell flow that sends reports through Outlook.
summary: Sending repetitive status reports can become a manual overhead for IT teams. To simplify the process, I developed a PowerShell-based Outlook automation solution.
prompt: Use this page to present the email automation flow, the standardized message content, and the Outlook script that attaches and sends the daily report.

blocks.title: What It Does
blocks.text: The script creates an Outlook message, attaches the report, adds the recipient list, and sends the email automatically.

blocks.title: Sample Script
blocks.code:
$ReportFile = "C:\\Reports\\DailyStatus.xlsx" $Outlook = New-Object ` -ComObject Outlook.Application $Mail = $Outlook.CreateItem(0) $Mail.To = "manager@company.com" $Mail.CC = "team@company.com" $Mail.Subject = "Daily Endpoint Status Report" $Mail.HTMLBody = @" Hello Team,

Please find attached today's endpoint report.

Regards,
Automation System "@ $Mail.Attachments.Add($ReportFile) $Mail.Send() Write-Host "Mail sent successfully."
